articleTitle: Design of multiple rotating impact experiment system of high speed and heavy overload
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In view of the existing impact equipment can't meet the needs of continuous high speed impact experiment, a new type of high speed multiple impact experiment method is proposed and the principle of system design is also given. The experiment system is mainly composed of impact system, automatic feed system and the control system, Wherein the main components of the impact system is a horizontal turntable with a plurality of impact components evenly distributed on the edge of the turntable, convert the rotational kinetic energy into impact kinetic energy, apply high impact overload to the test component, when the turntable reaches the set speed, the automatic feed system feed the component to the experiment position in the designed window time, perform an impact experiment, the control system realizes the control of impact and automatic feed and return, also realizes the recovery of experiment data. On the basis of the completion of system design, a simulation model is established to verify the design, the simulation results show that the designed experiment system has the advantages of novel structure and superior performance, can realize high speed and heavy overload impact, of important scientific research significance and practical value.

articleTitle: A precise high-speed tracking and pointing control system of camera based on FPGA : Closed loop feedback control system to control the remote sensing camera lens moving
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper designed a precise high-speed tracking and pointing Control system of Camera based on FPGA. The control system can control the remote sensing camera lens moving accurately and flexibly. The system had the function of control angle position control speed and stable speed regulation. We used the step motor to be actuator. The acceleration and deceleration process was stable, effective and high precision. The system adopted the closed loop feedback method. Using the FPGA simplifies the structure of motor control system, reduced the system cost. The modular system can be widely used in various fields.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ control of average dwell time switching systems via non-monotonic lyapunov function approach
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper develops a non-monotonic Lyapunov function (LF) approach for discrete-time switching linear system with average dwell time (ADT) switching to improve the stability criterion and achieve better H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance. Such an approach allows the LF to increase both at the switching instants and during the running time of subsystems, but guarantees an average decrease on every two sampling steps. Based on the results of stability and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> analysis, a robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller is further designed. Moreover, the relationship between the time difference of LF and switching rate i.e. the ADT constraint, is revealed. An example is given to demonstrate the validity and potential of the developed results.

articleTitle: Motion planning for hexapod robot based on fitted curve
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to imitate biological gait subtly and develop the movement potential of the hexapod robot comprehensively, kinematics analysis and dynamics analysis are made to be foundation of mathematics. The adaptation of the analysis method is improved and the hexapod robot single-leg workspace equation is got with combining vector method and geometric method. Based on the relative motion theory, a method to transform body motion planning into foot path planning is presented to simplify the issue of body motion planning. The discrete gait model to disperse the foot path is presented, hence we can solve the path planning issue by choosing the suitable discrete foot point. Fitted curve model is adopted in our study on trajectory planning. It is proved by MATLAB modeling and simulation that the method of path planning can generate stable gait and coordinate legs efficiently to help hexapod robot in good motion control.

articleTitle: Input-Output finite-time stability and stabilization for a class of distributed parameter systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, the input-output finite-time stability and stabilization for distributed parameter systems was studied. The concept of input-output finite-time stability for distributed parameter systems was defined. By employing Lyapunov functional theory, sufficient conditions of input-output finite-time stability for distributed parameter systems were given. Sufficient conditions for the existence of distributed state feedback controllers which ensure the closed-loop distributed parameter systems be input-output finite-time stable were also proposed. Finally, a numerical example was given to illustrate our results.

articleTitle: Service identifying based weapon systems architecture optimization with K-clique community detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Service oriented view is introduced to DoDAF 2.0 in 2009 to solve the problem that lacking of reusability and flexibility caused of close coupling in WSA. However, services in service view are proposed by users subjectively, which would be work-consumed and incapable to guarantee the rationality and consistency of logic. Using a method of complex network field: k-clique community detection algorithm, the paper addressed the problem by mining services in WSA automated, which subsequently can play a rule in WSA optimization.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of the structure of robot arm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, a three-degree-of-freedom robot model is established to solve the problem of unstable structure of the manipulator. Using the finite element method, topology optimization, the key component of the robot, the rear arm. This paper carries out static analysis, lightweight design, to verify its stiffness and strength. For the improved arm structure, the structure is more stable, reasonable and lighter.

articleTitle: Phantom excludability algorithm based on speciality of sensor and target
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: A new phantom excludability algorithm based on speciality of sensor and target was proposed in this paper in order to exclude the false intersection points on direction finding process for emitting lines in passive cross location. Firstly, deduce the correlation stretch angle, candidate observation set and effective observation set with maximum detection range of each sensor, relative location of sensors and the target's specialities, then a credible range about angle correlation is presented. Secondly, find the location point set based on the base-line least distance algorithm. Simulation results validated the new disposal method of these two steps, not only the frequency of the correlation was decreased sharply, but also the probability of correct correlation and the real-time performance of the system were improved greatly.

articleTitle: Air brake backup system designe and analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The current bus brake system, that consists of two parts, air brake and exhaust brake. The exhaust brake system not enough to replace the air brake system. This research focuses on the new backup brake mechanism, using several valves and backup compressed air accumulators are inserted into the main brake system to provide brake force. When air brake failure, backup system can be using slow down and reduce brake distance for requirements ability and air brake to make vehicle can be safe. Finally, according to the experimental results, when the rear brake system failure, the proposed system can be let the vehicle brake performance keeps above 90% of the original performance. If the front and rear brake system failure, the backup brake mechanism still keep the brake performance about 75% of the original value.

articleTitle: Learning binary code features for UAV target tracking
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: During target tracking, in order to obtain a higher tracking accuracy, the region we would like to track should have a good feature expression. Furthermore, we need to extract multilevel and complex features to deal with problems which are usually encountered during UAV tracking, such as the target deformation, scale change and occlusion. However, such features make tracker more complex which would seriously affect the real-time tracking. Considering the above problems, we take the advantage of random forest for features selection, and then transform the features to binary code, which can not only reduce redundancy but speed up the tracker. In order to further improve the accuracy of UAV tracking, we utilize structured SVM for online learning to distinguish object from background. In addition, we apply the scale pyramid to achieve the scale invariance of tracker, which help to obtain a more precise position of the object. We have verified the effectiveness and robustness of our method on the classical UAV object tracking dataset UAV123.

articleTitle: AC impedance extraction for three phase systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Accurate modeling and stability analysis plays a vital role in all Electrical Power Systems (EPS) specifications. Stability criteria as defined by Middlebrook, is based on impedances of the interacting systems at interface point (i.e. source output impedance and load input impedance). This led to an enormous research on the impedance extraction for ac and dc systems till date. Accurate impedance measurements are hence required to validate modeling procedures as well as measure the stability of the interconnected power systems. This paper presents ac impedance extraction for source and load in three phase power systems using ABC-DQ0 transformation with utilization of fast Fourier transform (FFT). Results obtained prove sufficient matching with those of analytical and switching models hence validating impedance extraction technique.

articleTitle: Study of the obstacle avoidance plan of UAV based on IRIS algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Although unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) shows great advantages and some new potential applications in recent years as an effective tool for investigation, fighting and defense, yet, how to give full play to its role still remains the focus of attention. To improve the fighting efficiency of UAV and expand the range of its applications, the obstacle avoidance problem of UAV during autonomous cruise should be solved at first. This paper mainly studies the obstacle avoidance algorithm for UAV, and proposes an obstacle avoidance plan based on IRIS (Iterative Regional Inflation by Semidefinite) and APF (Artifical Potential Field), i.e. IRIS-APF obstacle avoidance plan. According to the requirements and constraints on UAV autonomous cruise, the IRIS and APF are optimized and combined effectively, to realize the IRIS algorithm in 2d and 3d environments, control the UAV avoidance of static obstacles in 2d environment, and ensure the general heading direction of UAV towards the target. Through simulation verification, the IRIS-APF obstacle avoidance plan proposed herein not only achieves the goal of obstacle avoidance, but also realizes high algorithm speed and accuracy under the high real-time request during UAV advancement process.

articleTitle: Analysis of damage probability of antiaircraft gun based on future airspace window
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to deal with maneuvering targets and improve the effectiveness of anti-aircraft gun system, the Future Airspace Window shooting system came into being for completing the task of air defense and anti missiles. aimed at the problems of traditional Concentrated Fire shooting system, the principle of Future Airspace Window is introduced and the model of Future Airspace Window shooting system under the anti-aircraft gun damage probability is constructed. The burst damage probability is simulated respectively on the condition of Concentrated Fire shooting system and the Future Airspace Window shooting system, based on uniform linear and maneuver motion of different route conditions. The results show that the Future Airspace Window shooting system has a better damage effect.

articleTitle: Research and test on traction control system of distributed driving electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The Traction Control System is the foundation to maintain the vehicle tractive performance and stability. In view of the characteristics of distributed driving electric vehicle, a traction control method is designed to control the wheel slip rate by adjusting the motor torque directly. And through reasonable correction to the target wheel speed, a balance of acceleration and stability of automobile can be reached. The results of simulation and real vehicle test show that the control algorithm can achieve the control target of restricting four wheel slip of the vehicle on the uniform, split and opposite adhesion road.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling of indoor air temperature based on power spectral density method
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The control of indoor thermal conditions needs dynamic modeling of indoor air temperature in buildings. The indoor air temperature is influenced by four factors: outdoor weather conditions occupants; plug-in electric load used in air-conditioning zones; and cooling and heating energy consumed by air-conditioning system. Weather conditions, occupants and plug-in electric load are considered as random variables, while cooling and heating energy consumption are marked as deterministic variables. Step response method is a commonly method used for modeling. But step signals of random variables in real operation can hardly generated. This paper presents a power spectral density method for dynamically modeling of indoor air temperature response which contains a numerous of random variables. In order to simplify the analysis, this paper selects the ambient temperature and total solar radiation as the input variables and the indoor temperature as the output variable for analysis. Power spectral density and cross spectral density of different is calculated and transfer function is established. In the case of multiple input variables, the state space method is used to establish the transfer function. The proposed method was applied in a real room, and then model predictive control (MPC) strategy was applied based on this model. The result shows that the accuracy and the practicality of the model are all satisfactory.

articleTitle: Interleaved sampling and concurrent filter of optic-fiber distributed temperature sensors
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper presents an embedded solution of concurrent low-pass filter and sample interleaving system which process back-scattered signal of optic-fiber distributed temperature sensors at 250 MSPS. The logic design is implemented on a data acquisition platform with four ADC channels and FPGA-ARM processors; samples from two ADCs are merged and reconstructed to double the equivalent sampling rate. A low-cost FPGA processes Stokes and anti-Stokes signals from up to 20000 measurement locations along the fiber. In the experiments the comparison between interleaved data and original data shows that quantization noises around input signal frequency were evidently reduced but small distortions of high frequency were introduced. The concurrent filter guaranteed a SNR of 42.3 for the distributed temperature sensors.

articleTitle: A P300 brain-computer interface design for virtual remote control system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: A convenient way for controlling household appliances using a remote controller is not suitable for movement-disabled patients. To provide an alternative for such people, some applications on controlling household devices have been developed recently. However, there are some shortcomings in those control systems. Because the brain activities are reserved in movement-disabled patients, we proposed a virtual remote control system using a P300 Brain-computer interface (BCI), which allows users to communicate with outside by focused attention. Both offline and online experiments were implemented to verify the feasibility of virtual BCI-based remote control system. The validation results demonstrated that the designed system achieved a good performance, which may meet practical requirements.

articleTitle: Automatic control and measurement of rotating speed of a rotor system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to achieve the requirement that the rotating speed of a rotor can be automatically controlled and measured by computer, a new control and measurement scheme based on computer technique is investigated in this paper. The scheme uses an inverter to control the electric motor. And meanwhile, a data acquisition system is used to sample the impulse signal to compute the rotating speed of the rotor. A test experiment, subsequently, is performed on a rotor-bearing rig. Experiment results show that the proposed scheme not only can automatically control the rotating speed of the rotor but also can accurately measuring its real-time speed.

articleTitle: Parameter estimation and convergence analysis for a class of canonical dynamic systems by extended kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: There were many researches about the parameter estimation of canonical dynamic systems recently. Extended Kalman filter (EKF) is a popular parameter estimation method in virtue of its easy applications. This paper focuses on parameter estimation for a class of canonical dynamic systems by EKF. By constructing associated differential equation, the convergence of EKF parameter estimation for the canonical dynamic systems is analyzed. And the simulation demonstrates the good performance.

articleTitle: Hybrid RSS-based fingerprinting positioning method with segmentation and KNN in cellular network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Positioning method based on Receive Signal Strength (RSS) is one of the outdoor positioning methods that have a wide range of applications in wireless communication networks. Thus, the main purpose of this paper is to investigate RSS fingerprint-based positioning in cellular wireless networks. In this work, we propose a hybrid algorithm that integrates KNearest Neighbor (KNN) location-based fingerprint approach with fingerprint location estimation based on segmentation approach to improve the positioning accuracy. The performance of the proposed method was evaluated by data that are collected in a dense urban environment. The experimental tests discussed in this paper show that the proposed segmentation-based fingerprinting method provides satisfactory results of localization in an urban environment.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop model reference fractional adaptive control for a class of wiener systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of block-oriented Wiener systems control. Designing controllers for Wiener systems face many challenges, for instance, parameter uncertainty and lack of state measurement. To address these issues, the input-output response of a class of Wiener systems is represented with a simple fractional-order model, then a closed-loop model reference fractional adaptive controller (CMRFAC) is designed. Simulations illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control.

articleTitle: Trajectory optimization of aerodynamically controlled missiles using pseudospectral method
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The trajectory optimization of aerodynamically controlled missiles in the terminal phase is studied using Radau Pseudospectral Method (RPM). We first establish this complex trajectory optimization problem with angle of attack and bank angle as control variables. Impact angle and dynamic pressure constraints are taken into account. Then, the formulation of nonlinear programming problem (NLP) using RPM is stated in detail. Finally, application to hypersonic gliding vehicle is carried out based on GPOPS toolbox and the results illustrate the effectiveness and high accuracy of RPM.

articleTitle: Analysis of inverse kinematics method for six degrees of freedom manipulator based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, the kinematics model of six-DOF manipulator is established by D-H parameter method, and the joint space method is used to carry out trajectory planning. Then, we use the Robotics Toolbox of Matlab to solve the inverse kinematics of each trajectory curve, the joint angle curves draw on the time axis exist local mutation, and then adopt the inverse kinematics method based on the fsolve function, the resulting joint angle curves are both continuous and smooth, which solves the mutation problem. Finally, the Fourier function is used to fit the joint angle curves to generate functions of them, from which the Actual trajectory curve is obtained is close to the theoretical trajectory curve and the coincidence degree is high.

articleTitle: Design of multi-channel electric energy metering and charge-monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In electric vehicle charging equipment, energy metering is a basic function, and the real-time monitoring for the safety of the charging process is essential. Electric vehicle AC charging pile is a convenient and efficient electric vehicle charging equipment, but the internal module of traditional AC charging pile scatters seriously. The volume of the AC charging pile is so large that is not conducive to equipment installation, commissioning and routine maintenance. STM32F107 is set as the master core, while ADE7816 is set as an important device to measure current, voltage and power and it can detect overcurrent, overvoltage and zero crossing. The system was designed from the three aspects of the principle scheme, the hardware circuit and the software programming respectively, and the prototype has been developed. After tested, the system can achieve desired functions, such as multi-charging port charging at the same time, real-time monitoring of charging process, which provided technical means for the intelligent and lightweight of charging equipment, especially multi-user charging equipment.

articleTitle: The deployment dynamics of a new mixed space web
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Active debris removal and defunct satellites mitigation is one of current hot spots in space research. Based on the deployment process, a new mixed space web is proposed in present paper. Firstly, the Vector Form Intrinsic Finite Element Method and “Kelvin-Voigt” viscoelastic constitution relation are adopted to establish the dynamic model of space web. Then the reliability of the simulation model is validated by the ground test. Finally, the deployment dynamics of new mixed space web are simulated and analysed. The results show that: compared to the traditional space web, the new mixed space web is better-distributed in bearing the loads, dissipates less energy and shows clear deployment mechanism.

articleTitle: Study on release region of guided bombs based on multi-island genetic algorithm and quadratic programming
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Release region boundary is related with the utmost trajectory of guided bombs. As a result, the boundary issue can be transformed into many rounds of optimal range calculation through a simple translation transformation. Particle trajectory models for a certain guided bomb on surfaced-launched and off-axis are built. Then, genetic algorithm's inevitable shortcomings of immature convergence phenomenon and slowly convergence speed when closing to global optimal value is proposed. In order to avoid that, combinatorial optimization algorithm using multi-island genetic algorithm and quadratic programming is developed. Numerical simulation results show that the algorithm is effective and more efficient.

articleTitle: Optimization of power grid structure considering comprehensive maintenance
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: It is of great significance to study the optimization of grid structure considering comprehensive maintenance. In this paper, a mathematical model of optimal planning for comprehensive maintenance of power grid was established. The model can consider various technical measures to meet the comprehensive maintenance of power grid, and consider the operation status of power grid. An optimization model of power grid integrated maintenance was built, and an optimization model based on Tabu search was proposed. The above theory and method are applied to the optimal planning of Chaoyang Power Grid, which is a typical city in Liaoning, and the validity and practicability of the method are verified.

articleTitle: Research on virtual maintenance disassembly sequence planning for weapons equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Virtual maintenance is a new method of maintenance technology, which has deficiencies in disassembly planning, especially in the constraint of ergonomics factors and the hierarchical division of the components. On the basis of Petri net, the interpretative structural model is introduced to divide the equipment components and simplify the description of the maintenance disassembly process. In order to ensure the feasibility of the disassembly sequence, the ergonomics factors are introduced, which can be evaluated by jack platform. Genetic algorithm is used to define the planning objectives, constraints, codec in the process of virtual maintenance disassembly, and a certain type of gearbox is taken as the experiment evaluation, which verifies the high-efficiency of the designed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on MAC efficiency for broadband PLC access network
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The Low Voltage Power Line Communication (LVPLC) MAC protocols are an important influence factor for the network efficiency. To solve the existing problem that p persistent CSMA leads distinctly poor MAC efficiency under heavy loads in the same collision domain, we propose an adaptive p persistent CSMA efficiency optimization protocol for the finite loads in LVPLC mesh network. This protocol reduces collision probability to the data packets, optimizes the power line channel transmission status and maximizes the MAC efficiency by dynamically adjusting and controlling the probability p based on the number of the active stations. The simulation results show that the proposed protocol retains its maximum efficiency about 6.5%, compared with static p persistent CSMA.

articleTitle: Research on measurement matrix based on compressed sensing theory
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Compressed Sensing is for sparse and compressible signals, the data is compressed while the signal is sampled. This paper proposes the new deterministic measurement matrices that are studied: according to the compressible signal characteristics, we will use the unit matrix added with random orthogonal matrix and complementary sequences as the measurement matrix, and then using orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm to reconstruct the signal, we can safely draw that as deterministic measurement matrix, they are feasible to reconstruct the original signal accurately. The simulation results show that the performances of the unit matrix added with random orthogonal matrix and complementary sequences are not only superior the partial Hadamard matrix, but also better than the Gaussian random measurement matrix.

articleTitle: On development of stoke sensing system for magnetic-grating-like hydraulic cylinder
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: A displacement sensing system with the prototype of magnetic-grating-like hydraulic cylinder is developed. It consists of a signal acquisition module, a signal conditioning module, a signal processing module, a signal isolation module and an electrical stimulator module. The system realizes signal processing with the application of tangent segmentation principle. Tests of this devised system have been carried out on laboratory setup. Experimental studies and data analysis are performed to verify the significance of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Impedance extraction utilizing improved average models for three phase diode rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Switching models possess discontinuous and nonlinear behavior rendering difficulties in simulations in terms of time consumption, computational complexity causing mathematical instability while equally vulnerable to errors. This issue can be sorted out by averaging detailed models over entire switching period. Several static as well as dynamic average models (full order and reduced order) have been proposed which proved to be applicable at different scenarios. This paper presents an improved average model of three phase (six-pulse) diode rectifier by approximating load current to first order Taylor series which captures the static as well as dynamic behavior of the switching model. Small signal output impedance for switching, average model and experimental setup is obtained using small signal injection technique. Impedances of each integral part in interconnected AC/DC/AC systems are necessary for determining the overall stability of the complete system. Results obtained prove sufficient matching hence validating the modeling procedure and technique.

articleTitle: Study on effect of combination of traditional chinese and western medicine on the treatment of hepatitis B by adefovior
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Hepatitis B is one of serious infectious diseases in the wold. Most chronical Hepatitis B patients need lifelong time's therapy. Evaluating the efficacy of anti-hepatitis virus infection treatment is very important. This paper uses the multiple linear regression with normalization approach to predict the efficacy of the traditional Chinese medicine and Adefovior anti-hepatitis B virus infection therapy for poor response and complete response patients. Results showed that based on the patients' clinic HBV DNA, ALT and HBeAg data collected at the week 24, the multiple linear regression models with normalization are able to predict the poor response and the complete response patients' outcome half years earlier in more than 90% accuracy.

articleTitle: Car ownership prediction based on model combination
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: According to the characteristics of car ownership prediction influenced by multi-factor and non-linear, a combination forecasting model was proposed based on principal component analysis (PCA) and BP neural network for the purpose of car ownership prediction. Take the national car ownership as an example, the principal component analysis is carried out on the factors affecting the car ownership, and the input samples of the BP neural network are constructed according to the determined principal component, so as to forecast the car ownership in different years. The result shows that the relative error of PCA-BP neural network is less than ± 5%. At the same time, compared with the BP neural network, PCA-BP neural network combination forecasting model is more accurate and precise.

articleTitle: Suppression of harmonic current in magnetically suspended rotor system based on frequency adaptive fractional compensation RC
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Due to the existence of mass unbalance and sensor runout, magnetically suspended rotor (MSR) system will generate harmonic current. The ratio of sampling frequency to fundamental frequency of the harmonic current is not always an integer. However, the existing repetitive controller (RC) for harmonic current suppression of MSR can only compensate for the cases where the ratio is an integer, so the accuracy will be degraded. To address this issue, a frequency adaptive fractional compensation repetitive controller (FCRC) that combines integer delay link and fractional delay link is proposed in this paper. Meanwhile, the low-pass filter in the feedback loop is moved to the outside of the loop. To verify the feasibility and superiority of the proposed method, experiments are carried out.

articleTitle: A video stabilization algorithm for train-mounted intrusion detection system based on ALP keypoints
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: With the rapid increasing of railway mileage, automatic railway intrusion detection by analyzing the video from train-mounted camera is becoming very meaningful. But there exits serious jitter in the video since the camera always vibrates with train when it is running, a video stabilization reprocessing procedure is the prerequisite before the intrusion detection analysis. To solve this question, a robust video stabilization algorithm based on low degree polynomial detector is presented in this paper. Generally, this algorithm consists of three stages. Firstly, keypoints are extracted and tracked by ALP detector and KLT tracker respectively between adjoining frame of the video. Secondly, the local motion vector is obtained by image affine transformation model. Finally, the global motion vectors are corrected and smoothed by using RANSAC and Kalman filter respectively. At the end of this paper, experiments based on PSNR and ITF values are given to show that the proposed algorithm is more effective than Harris corner detector which is often used in the traditional stabilization algorithm.

articleTitle: An improved dial's loading algorithm for traffic equilibrium models
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The paper proposes an efficient algorithm, one improved Dial's loading algorithm (IDLA), for determining the approximate solution of logit-based stochastic user equilibrium model (SUE). Since the user equilibrium (UE) model is an extreme case of the SUE, the algorithm can also be applied to the UE. In this paper, we firstly present the framework of the IDLA for both only one OD pair and multi-OD pairs. Then the convergence property is discussed. Finally one numerical example is computed in Matlab which validates the feasibility of the IDLA.

articleTitle: Signal processing and transmission in GIS flashover fault location system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper introduces the detection principle of Gas-Insulated Switchgear(GIS) ultrasonic testing method for the fault location of flashover. We designed the GIS flashover fault location monitoring system, which solved the problem of low precision and time-consuming for the detection of GIS. We designed the hardware and software of the monitoring system. We use the three op amp differential amplifier circuit in front processing circuit of the hardware part to suppress the common mode signal in the signals. When the signal is processed by software, the method of wavelet soft and hard threshold is designed to remove the noise in the signal and improve the signal to noise ratio. We achieve the task of wireless data transmission through the ZigBee2007Pro protocol stack. Experimental platform is built to verify the reliability of the GIS flashover fault location system, which can improve the positioning accuracy and fault location, and has the advantages of low cost, portability and so on.

articleTitle: The algorithm of channel estimation based on IEEE802.11ac
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The conventional algorithm of channel estimation based on IEEE802.11ac is Least Square (LS) algorithm, which uses the Very High Throughput-Long Training Field (VHTLTF) of frame header as training sequence. While the conventional algorithm does not take into account the effects of noise and the varying characteristics of channel in time domain. In order to describe the slow change of channel in time domain, this paper considers that the VHT-LTF is linearly interpolated in the frames. To suppress the impact of noise, this paper proposes the Linear Minimum Mean Square Error (LMMSE) algorithm in frequency domain and utilizes a Wiener filter window function to approximate the correlation function in LMMSE. Simulation result shows that LMMSE provides 4dB SNR better than LS at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> BER.

articleTitle: An improved departed domain control strategy for acrobot
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: We propose an improved strategy for control of underactuated two-link manipulator named acrobots. Initial conditions of nonlinear systems determine its trajectory even under same control law, so we introduce a firing control law to change initial conditions, which leads a better performance. The motion space is divided into three areas: firing, swing-up and attractive; control laws for each are designed. For swing-up area, a control law based on a weak-control Lyapunov function(WCLF) is employed to increase the energy and control the posture of the actuated link For attractive area, a control law based on poles placement is designed. Stability is guaranteed in the swing-up area by the use of a WCLF based on LaSalle's invariance principle. Finally, an example is used to compare with previous results.

articleTitle: PD feature extraction based on cross-wavelet transform and PCA
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aimed at the high sensitivity to noise in partial discharge (PD) pattern recognition, a novel feature extraction method based on cross-wavelet transform and Principal Component Analysis is proposed. Cross-wavelet transform of PD signals provides new characteristic parameters for pattern recognition. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to reduce dimensions of the new selected parameters. Back Propagation Neural Network, Radial Basis Function Neural Network and Probabilistic Neural Network classifiers are utilized for PD pattern recognition. Results demonstrate that, the proposed feature extraction approach can reduce the influence of noises. And the recognition results are encouraging with a reasonable accuracy.

articleTitle: Delay-Dependent stabilization for hybrid stochastic delay systems by discrete-time feedback control
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In 2013, Mao initiated the study on the stabilization of continuous-time hybrid stochastic differential equations by feedback controls based on discrete-time state observations. In this paper, we will extend the theory to deal with the robust discrete-state-feedback stabilization problem for hybrid stochastic systems with time-varying delay. By employing the Razumikhin technique, delay-dependent criterion to determine controllers and time lags is firstly established. Then the LMI method to design the controller based on discrete-time state observations is developed. Finally, an example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of our results.

articleTitle: Research of power management for fuel cell/supercapacitors hybrid system based on passivity-based control
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper focuses on power management strategy for a hybrid system involving the Fuel Cell (FC) as the main power source and the Supercapacitors (SCs) as the auxiliary power source. An innovative Passivity-based Control (PBC) strategy with multi-equilibrium states is proposed. The hybrid system is modeled as a Port-controlled Hamiltonian (PCH) system and then the operating modes and the corresponding multi-equilibrium states of the hybrid system are analyzed. Additionally, the proposed PBC is designed based on Interconnection and Damping Assignment (IDA) method and the stability of the closed-loop system is proven theoretically. The simulation results show that the proposed PBC could stabilize the DC bus voltage without any steady state errors and reasonably balance the power distribution between the FC and the SC.

articleTitle: Adaptive grid interacting multiple model algorithm based on CKF
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: For nonlinear problem in target tracking, on the basis of maneuver turn model, the AGIMMCKF-algorithm is proposed, which is a variable multiple model algorithm that combined cubature kalman filter (CKF) with adaptive grid (AG). CKF as a filter, the algorithm using grid center and the adjustment of the minimum distance between grid to change turn model set adaptively so as to effectively track targets, and then compared with IMMCKF. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has higher tracking accuracy and stability compared with IMMCKF algorithm in the absence of an increase in running time.

articleTitle: Research on noise reduction algorithm based on packet digital average and correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to improve the signal-to-noise ratio(SNR) of the noise-contaminated signal and speed up the calculation speed. Firstly, digital average and correlation analysis two traditional methods is introduced in this paper, and then a new fusion algorithm method based on packet digital average and correlation analysis is proposed. Furthermore, simulations based on MATLAB of digital average, correlation analysis and fusion algorithm are used to verify the feasibility of fusion algorithm. The results show that fusion algorithm based on packet digital average and correlation analysis is better than digital average method and correlation analysis method in calculation speed and noise reduction effect for the same input SNR.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based automatic collimation research of optical fiber beam
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to measure the fiber parameters accurately and quickly, a kind of optical fiber beam collimation system is studied in this paper. The center of the beam image captured by the CCD camera is fed to the FPGA. Then the FPGA using the fuzzy self-tuning PID to controls multi-dimensional electric platform so that making the fiber vertical to the camera surface and achieving the beam automatic collimation. The results show that the fuzzy self-tuning PID control response adjustment time is about 0.8ms, faster than the PID response 0.3ms. At the same time, within 5mm of the radial direction of the fiber, the coordinate error of the center is less than 5um after the collimation. In the last measured fiber parameters, the measurement accuracy of the long and short axis divergence angle is also ± 0.1.

articleTitle: Functional model and stability analysis of 18-pulse auto-transformer rectifier unit (ATRU)
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This work mainly focuses on designing and modeling of 18-pulse autotransformer rectifier unit. The dq rotating reference frame (Park's Transformation) is used to design the average model. Polynomial fits are required to build up from essential parameters like α, k<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</inf> and k<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf> that must be extracted from switching model or actual setup. The designed model is computationally efficient, time invariant and has the key advantage of reduced simulation time, less convergence errors and having no numerical instabilities. The designed average model provides a much more accurate representation of the system dynamics both in frequency as well as in time domain. For this purpose, 18-pulse delta type autotransformer rectifier unit (ATRU) is modeled and analyzed for small signal behavior in order to realize the overall system stability. Finally average model is validated with hardware setup of 2 kVA prototype and its results are found to be closely matching with those of switching and average model proving the accuracy and reliability of the proposed model. Hence using these average models can greatly reduce the time consumption by avoiding mathematical instabilities while maintaining efficiency up to the mark on the other side.

articleTitle: Effects of SNRs on the measurement of spectra
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In the present paper, the effects of signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) on the measurement of 19 atomic Lick indices are analyzed. The stellar spectra of the large sky area multi-object fiber spectroscopic telescope (LAMOST) are selected under different conditions, which allows investigating the impact of SNRs on the accuracy and precision of the measurement of Lick/LAMOST indices. The experiment result shows that SNRs greatly affects the measurement of LAMOST/Lick indices in a complex manner. Normally, the precision of the measurement increases with SNRs with a linear trend and the affection of SNRs over 80 can be ignored. The proposed minimum SNRs is 25 according to the accuracy. Comparisons of the Lick indices under different conditions help to analyze the influence of SNRs on the precision of the measurements of LAMOST/Lick indices.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an efficient active equalization system for batteries
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This article design and implementation an efficient system which can balance the batteries quickly and accurately to solve the Problems of the batteries' safety and short life. For hardware systems, the Freescale's S912XET256J2MAA is used as the master chip and the equalization module is designed with EMB1428 and EMB1499. An efficient and accurate strategy also be designed and used in this system. Finally, the strategy uses the Simulink function in Matlab to model, automatically generate code, and then be downloaded to the hardware circuit to achieve balanced functions. The experimental results show that the system can make the battery echelon use complete efficient equilibrium within 7000s.

articleTitle: The factors affecting the continuance usage behavior of university students towards mobile online group-buying in China
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to explore the important factors that influence users' continuance usage behavior toward mobile online group-buying. Based on the characteristics of the mobile Internet, an extension of the UTAUT model is introduced to verify the proposed hypotheses. The structural equation modeling method is used to analyze the empirical data which come from universities in China. The results show that five factors are verified to influence university students' continuance usage behavior toward mobile online group-buying. The findings of this study may help the group-buying website and policymaker to better understand the users' usage behavior toward mobile online group-buying then take some actions or changes to keep the users' continuance usage behavior.

articleTitle: Study on optimal pressure tapping position of large diameter vortex flowmeter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Vortex flowmeter was firstly applied in industry control in late 1960s and widely used to take place of traditional flowmeters very soon. Considering the fact that research on large diameter vortex flowmeter is far behind requirement of industrial application, the author has proposed to conduct simulation on triangular column vortex 350mm diameter flowmeter based on the computational fluid dynamics theory. In flow field simulation water and air as transmitting medium has been analyzed and compared in affection of frequency and signal measurement. To determine the optimal pressure tapping position of 350mm diameter vortex flowmeter, check points have been set in various positions to obtain data of signal strength and signal to noise ratio under different flowing velocity. The results have proved that the optimal pressure tapping position should be 1.0 times of cut-off face from the vortex generating body.

articleTitle: Scheduling the hybrid flowshop problem using a global fruit fly optimizer
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper proposes an effective global Fruit Fly Optimization (GFFO) for the hybrid flowshop (HFS) problem with makespan criterion. To improve FFO's exploration ability, a global osphresis foraging and a global vision foraging is introduced. We calibrate the parameters and operators for the presented GFFO algorithm by means of a design of experiments approach. Comparative evaluations show that the proposed GFFO algorithm performs much better than the other algorithms in the literature in solving the HFS problem with makespan criterion.

articleTitle: Research on flexible self starting strategy of wind storage isolated network system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: With the rapid development and application of distributed generation, more and more attention has been paid to the operation and control technology of the wind storage isolated network system. As a kind of new energy application, the operation of wind storage isolated network system has a great technical advantage in the process of operation. Aiming at the problem of self starting and stable operation of the wind storage isolated network system, a flexible self starting method of wind storage isolated network system based on Petri network model for power deviation prediction model is proposed, and the mathematical model and control strategy of system module are established. Based on the established mathematical model and control strategy, the electromagnetic transient simulation model is built in the PSCAD environment. The simulation results show that the power control strategy of energy storage system based on Petri network can be more effective and reliable, which is provided technical basis and practical method for the operation and control of wind storage isolated network system.

articleTitle: Design of sliding mode control system for automatic transition and hover of helicopter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, a T-S fuzzy model of helicopter transition and hover is established as the dynamic characteristics of the helicopter vary with decline of height and decrease of speed. Based on the performance index requirement of automatic transition and hover, the pole assignment method is used to determine the feedback control parameters and regulating controller in full envelope of the automatic transition and hover is designed according to the theory of parallel distributed compensation. Eventually the sliding mode control law is designed. The simulation results show that the designed system in this paper is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A new filter design for low-cost GNSS attitude determination applications
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper proposes a new filter design optimized for GNSS attitude determination applications using low cost devices. The filter contains all relevant constraints and observations, including double differenced carrier phase and code observations along with MEMS-IMU observations. Benefited from the unified treatment, the priori information is well used during the resolution of double differenced GNSS observables. Hence, the success rate of integer ambiguity resolution as well as attitude determination is improved. A set of experiments were conducted to evaluate the performance of the method, compared with the traditional method. This paper uses RTKLIB[1], an open source platform to provide the results of traditional method. The new filter is proved to be capable of improving the attitude determination accuracy and reliability. Apart from the validation, a proposal for future work is also attached in this paper.

articleTitle: Control of chaos in a dual-ring er-doped fiber laser using a cycle signal
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: We study chaos-control of a dual-ring Er-doped fiber laser by perturbing periodically on the laser pump and present its physical model. Dynamics behavior of the dual-ring Er-doped fiber laser can be controlled to stabilize in a cycle state or other dynamics states when a periodic signal is used to modulate the pump. When the pump is perturbed or modulated by a periodic square wave signal, chaotic behaviors of the laser dual-ring can be controlled and the two rings can deduce two single-periodic states while two rings emit cycle pulses. It indicates that chaotic dual-ring Er-doped fiber laser is pressured or controlled. When another periodic square wave signal is used to perform on the laser, dynamics behavior of dual-ring of the laser is educed to present multi-periodic states. When the pump is modulated by a sinusoidal signal, dynamics of the laser is controlled to deduce to other cycle states while each ring emits cycle pulses. And we find chaos-control region. Chaotic behavior of the laser can be controlled via the chaos-control method.

articleTitle: Instruction set architecture impact on design space subsetting for configurable systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: A major challenge in design space subsetting is the time consumed in evaluating all of the design space configurations and selecting a subset of best/near-best configurations - those that adhere closely to design constraints. If an architect determines a subset for an instruction set architecture (ISA) that is historically coupled the system's domain, the evaluation process must be repeated if the architect is to consider an alternative ISA, wasting precious design time. In this paper, we compare different ISAs' best configuration subsets and investigate the possibility of selecting an ISA-independent subset that provides good domain constraint adherence regardless of the ISA.

articleTitle: An application technology research about FO/AO based on MES system
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, through the technology comparison analysis of the process planning and FO/AO, it is concluded that the process expression and management form of FO/AO are more suitable for the control of aircraft technical status. Integrated secondary development of MES system and CAPP system, it implements display form of FO/AO and process control based on MES system, and meets the requirement of the organic combination of operational information and manufacturing process information during production process. At the same time, through to MES system fully implementing electronic FO/AO, cancel paper process planning and apply the manufacturing record card on the production site. It saves laborers invalid working time and improves the production efficiency, and also provides a guarantee for the accurate calculation of parts production and assembly cycle. It provides more accurate data sources for the balance of production line capacity and production planning.

articleTitle: Research on GPS orientation of large particular vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In view of the positioning, orientation and attitude measurement for large special vehicles, how to accurately receive vehicle running status, monitor all aspects of transportation, and to provide decision-making information for drivers and managers has become a key problem. This research puts forward to install three GPS receiving terminal antenna on the same baseline, while the distance between antenna varies from 14cm to 6m. GPS module synchronously receives carrier phase observation measurements from satellites, and uses the Least Squares Method to rapidly calculates baseline vector length between two antenna center points, so as to obtain the reference heading, rolling and pitching angles to datum. The experimental results show that under the baseline of 6m, the positioning operation only takes 1 second, and the accuracy of heading, rolling and pitching angles is higher than 0.5mil, which proves the method be appropriate to be widely used for the positioning, orientation and attitude measurement for large special vehicles.

articleTitle: Design of milling machine control system based on root locus method
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper aims to add a controller to the exiting milling machining transfer function according to some design requirements, while establishing a control system based on Simulink simulation, the system corrected through Mat lab simulation. This experiment uses advanced correction methods to improve the system performance, observe its step and ramp response to determine the parameters needs be used to describe the corrector. The basic idea of this correction is use using the bodes diagrams and root locus method to check the system is stable or not through the static gain, root locus gain will be used to improve the system through the phase lead and phase lag methods, simulation analysis of the steady state error of the closed loop transfer function ramp input and the analyses of the step response of the open loop transfer function of the system overshoot will be used as good indicator to obtain the design requirements.

articleTitle: A contactless method to measure the electrical conductivity
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Using eddy current method, we developed a simple system to measure the electrical conductivity of material contactlessly. Three coils were used in this method. One coil was used to produce the excitation magnetic field. The other two coils were used to compose the differential detection coil to detect the magnetic field produced by the eddy current. Using this method, we evaluated the electrical conductivity of copper alloy specimens with different fatigue testing conditions and found that the electrical conductivity of copper alloy had some relation with the damage of copper alloy. In the future, we will also use this method to measure the conductivity of the graphene composite film on aluminum foil.

articleTitle: Exploiting heterogeneity in grid for deformable part models
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Deformable part models (DPM) is a typical machine-learning based detection technique. It can achieve great success in detecting accuracy, but have compute-intensive tasks which severely restricts its utilization in many real world applications. In order to get high frame-rate for practical use, accelerators and grid computing infrastructure are needed. This paper propose a grid scheduling scheme which maintain two queues for GPUs and SW processors. The scheme obtain good scalability results through a lot of experiment. The experimental result on single processor node indicates that the parallel implementation on accelerators can achieve speedup up to 3x.

articleTitle: Automatic classification of WDMS spectra based on improved fisher classifier
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) has released the latest data (DR13) which is the first data release for the MaNGA survey. The massive spectra produced by SDSS is available for large sample research and also data source of rare and special objects like white dwarf main-sequence star (WDMS). Many techniques have been proposed to solve SDSS automatic classification problems with massive spectra and have important significance for improving the rate of scientific output of telescope. In this paper, an improved Fisher classifier is implemented for the classification of WDMS spectra in SDSS DR13. The inspiring experimental results show that this method is practical. In addition, this method can also be applied to the automatic classification of other specified objects in massive spectra without human involvement.

articleTitle: Design of LXI bus and SCPI analytical platform for battery simulator
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Battery Simulator is a kind of test equipment commonly used in satellite power, electric vehicles and other power application fields. Design a battery simulator with a standard LXI bus interface is important for building a multi-instrument test system. This paper puts forward a SCPI instruction analytical platform based on LXI bus. Remote PC sends SCPI command over LXI bus. The communication board of battery simulator receives via VXI-11 protocol, and parses the command into a local instruction, then sends it to DSP control board via Modbus RTU protocol. This process will realize PC remote control of battery simulator. Test result of VXI-11 and Modbus RTU shows the practicality of the analytical platform.

articleTitle: Signal singular point analysis method based on scales adaptive wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In the process of signal singularity detection using wavelet transform, there is not a unified standard on wavelet basis selection and scale selection. In the process of scale decomposition, the traditional method uses binary scale decomposition, which will limit the analysis of some signal results. The author has improved the deficiency, and the adaptive selection decomposition scale is used to replace the binary scale decomposition scale. The results show that the improved adaptive selective decomposition method can detect the singularity of the signal and improve the detection accuracy of the singularity of the signal effectively.

articleTitle: Model of platform-task relation optimization match based on M-best algorithm and rollout strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Considering the influence of resource redundancy in mission planning problem, mathematical model in pursuit of maximal task execution accuracy and minimal resource redundancy is established. Then, mixed integer branch-and-bound method is used to generate the best assignment of a single task, m-best algorithm based on decision space partition algorithm generates m sub-optimal assignment of each task, and an approach based on rollout strategy equalizes all task execution accuracy by decreasing the high priority tasks'. Finally, the availability and applicability of this method are illuminated by two cases, one of which is particularity and the other is generated by Monte-Carlo.

articleTitle: Application of a new denoising algorithm in hemispherical resonant gyro vibration signal processing
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the noise of the hemispherical resonant gyro (HRG) output signal is serious in the actual work, this paper proposes a new wavelet threshold denoising algorithm based on the random error term. Vibration noise is one of the main reasons that affect the accuracy of HRG in the actual work, so in this paper, the output signal of HRG under the vibration test is collected, to simulate the output in the actual work. And then, the signal denoising is carried out. The results show that the improved wavelet threshold denoising algorithm is effective and it solves the problem of noise mismatch or noise residue existing in the previous denoising algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on temperature control system of air conditioning room based on fuzzy control
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, the air conditioning room temperature model is established and the temperature control system based on the model is designed. What's more, the fuzzy control system of air conditioning room temperature is obtained. Finally, the effect of PID controller and fuzzy controller is compared by simulation. The simulation results show that the fuzzy control system designed in this paper can realize the continuous control, reduce the indoor temperature fluctuation, and increase the comfort of air conditioning room.

articleTitle: Dynamics and controller design of contactless electromagnetic de-tumbling for disabled satellite
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Most of the disabled spacecraft are spun, which are dangerous to other normal work spacecraft. Therefore, the disabled spacecraft need to be cleared and the first step is de-tumbling its angular velocity to an acceptable value. This paper investigates the dynamics and controller design of electromagnetic de-tumbling, analyzes the effects of the Earth's magnetic field, the inclination and the orbit height, and utilizes the `Two-to-One' de-tumbling mode which eliminates the incidental electromagnetic force actuated on the disabled spacecraft.

articleTitle: Initial-Data-Parameterized linear quadratic stochastic optimal control problems with random jumps
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: A stochastic control problem is formulated and we get the explicit form of the optimal control for initial-data-parameterized linear quadratic stochastic optimal control problems with random jumps. The optimal control can be proved to be unique. A stochastic Riccati equation is rigorous derived from the stochastic Hamilton system, which provides an optimal feedback control. This completes the the interrelationship between the stochastic Riccati equation and stochastic Hamilton system as two different but equivalent tools for the stochastic linear quadratic problem.

articleTitle: Fractional order PID control of a motion platform
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, the fractional order PID (FOPID) control scheme of a 3-axis motion platform is proposed. Firstly, a mathematical model of the 3-axis motion platform is derived, then a control law is developed to track the angular position. Tuned FOPID controller is compared with classic PID controller (IOPID). The simulation results are provided to verify the efficiency and correctness of the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: Model parameter identification and advance control of reaction regeneration system based on PPSO
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper partially-perturbed particle swarm optimization (PPSO) is applied for the parameter identification in Reaction - Regeneration System Model. Based on the mechanism model, the experimental data are obtained, and the first order plus dead time (FOPDT) mathematical model is established for different groups of parameters. We use the double input-double output (DIDO) Robustness, Tracking, Disturbance rejection - overall Aggressiveness (RTD-A) controller to control the identification model. The experimental results show that the identified model is consistent with the mechanism model in certain grouping conditions. The control effect of the DIDO RTD-A controller is significantly better than that of the IMC-PID controller.

articleTitle: A two-layer model for gene clustering using poly(A) site data
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Alternative polyadenylation (APA) can lead to various mRNA isforms differing in their 3' UTR, which contributes to the dynamics of gene regulation, including stability, localization and translation of mRNA. However, clustering of genes using poly(A) site data has not been extensively studied. Here we constructed a two-layer model based on canonical correlation analysis (CCA) to explore the clustering of genes with the consideration of the distribution and abundance of APA sites. We adopted the widely used hierarchical clustering with Average-Linkage (Hc-A), Complete-Linkage (Hc-C), and Single-Linkage (Hc-S) to comprehensively compare the proposed method with four distance measures including Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC), Euclidean distance (EUC), Manhattan distance (MAN), and Maximum distance (MAX) based on three performance indexes. Results showed that the proposed method performed better than other four distance measures and could generate clusters with more biological meaning and underlying molecular mechanisms.

articleTitle: Research on extraction of useful angular velocity information of superfluid gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aimed at the difficulty to extract the angular velocity information, which is polluted by the noise of superfluid gyroscope, a useful angular velocity information extraction method based on least mean square (LMS) algorithm was proposed. First, considering the existence of noise, the noise equivalent angular velocity model of gyroscope was established, and the amplitude range of noise equivalent angular velocity was analyzed. Second, a gyroscope noise cancellation system based on LMS adaptive filtering was proposed. Finally, by analyzing the influence of step factor and filter order on the filtering effect, the best parameter was obtained. The simulation results show that the noise can be effectively suppressed, and the useful angular velocity information can be extracted effectively.

articleTitle: Observability, time-varying stability and feedback control of discrete-time antilinear systems
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper investigates some properties of discrete-time antilinear systems. The observability of this kind system is examined by the certain gram matrix. As to the time-varying stability of the discrete- time anti-linear system, a time-varying discrete anti-Lyapunov equation is proposed for actual operation. Meanwhile, the observability, and the controllability of feedback control are expressed by the discriminant matrices for the time-invariant case. All the theorems are proved by rigorous mathematical expressions.

articleTitle: Undergraduate creative inquiry of swarm robotics: Communication methods
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper describes an undergraduate research project exploring techniques of swarm robotics using Roomba. The objective of this paper is to analyze each individual Roomba and successfully acquire communication between them. The Creative Inquiry undergraduate research group identify the most effective method of communication. The program that gives the best result is initialized in the IDE (Integrated Development Environment) and executed in the microcontroller called, Arduino.

articleTitle: The feasibility study on ship static electric field tracking based on extended kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Static Electric Field generated by stable current produced in the seawater surrounding ship has obvious distribution characteristics. We study the extend Kalman Filter to tracking ship with its SE signal. Frist, according to the movement characteristics of the target ship, state space model is built. Ship model is built with point currents line array model. Then, the least squares method is applied in the linear constrain on state of target ship considering the actually physical condition. Simulation results demonstrate that this method is feasible for the field of the real-time tracking of ship with the advantage of high preciseness.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of schematically tests of state of switches in distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The reliability of the power supply is an important index to evaluate the technology of distribution networks. The burn-in and failure of switches in distribution networks, the artificially maintenance plan and testing switches will reduce the reliability of the power supply of distribution networks. In this paper, we have proposed a method of schematically testing state of switches in distribution networks. We can check state of switches in distribution networks by means of the method to ensure that switches have a good state of remotely controlled and reduce artificially testing switches and planned outages. Finally we can efficiently exclude the trouble of the failure of switches and improve the reliability of the power supply of distribution networks.

Author Keywords: the reliability of the power supply

articleTitle: The studies of a mechanical model for adhesively bonded PZT actuator
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, through researching principles for the bonded PZT drive and analyzing the second class of piezoelectric force - electric couple, a model along the length of PZT-driven model to the mechanical vibration was established based on continuum dynamics. The interaction between the PZT and the structure of the bonding layer was the key factor during investigation. Followed by construction of the model, it was subject to a calculation example for evaluating its feasibility and advantages. Under the harmonic effect of the alternating voltage, the Time Chart of the transfer shear, the shear stress distribution, and other related results regarding to the adhesive layer were obtained. Moreover, the effect of physical properties and the layer thickness on the PZT driving force was determined.

articleTitle: Robust finite-time control of coupled spacecraft using dual quaternion
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: A novel terminal sliding control scheme is proposed to solve the coordinated control problem of coupled spacecraft. The integrated translational and rotational dynamics is employed using dual quaternion. A model-independent terminal sliding controller is further proposed such that the defined dynamical synchronization error can converge to the desired trajectory in finite time. Numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: HPSO in the application of the equipment maintenance task scheduling
publicationTitle: 2017 3rd IEEE International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
